items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Two guys. Louis Cotrell and Paul Detroit. ... That was my man. Yes. Paul Detroit, because I used to like to hear, I'd get him at the theater in time to hear him come out and tune up his drums, you know. He used to sound so good.

ctx.x: Well I was going to ask you now what drummers influenced you? If any.
Two guys. Louis Cotrell and Paul Detroit.
